title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15
lineage: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC
source: Aiwa hand-held microphone -> Master Reel (Aiwa 5" reel-to-reel) -> Alesis Masterlink 9600 -> Hard Drive -> CD

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality audience recording of a powerful ’69 show highlighted by an incendiary Dark Star and strong jams
ai_review.review: The performance shines with a scorching Dark Star, a standout Cryptical > Dark Star sequence, a ballistic The Other One and rare moments like Pig’s harp on It Hurts Me. The audience tape captures the raw ’69 vibe but suffers from garage‑band‑like muddiness and occasional harshness (especially on Eleven), so listeners should expect a rough mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised with several standout jams, while recording quality is described as mediocre but acceptable for an audience tape; the weighted average yields a solid >4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crappy/garage‑band sound noted, needs EQ, occasional harshness on Eleven, but captures period ambience; overall listenable for fans despite muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy set with strong transitions (notably Cryptical into Dark Star) and rare moments that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Dark Star described as ‘yelling’ and ‘evil’, showcasing his intense guitar work.
